definition: Multi Modal Massive Web, an image and text dataset by DeepMind.
details: Multi Modal Massive Web, an image and text dataset by DeepMind. This is used to train Flamingo, a multimodal LLM.

explainer.lead: M3W (Multi Modal Massive Web) is an image and text dataset by DeepMind. It matters because it is used to train Flamingo, a multimodal LLM.

tiers.eli5: It is a huge pile of web pages, pictures and words together, used as study material for a model that learns from both.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers use it as the image-text training corpus for a multimodal model. The pitfall to watch is scope: the given facts cover only its contents and its use for Flamingo.
tiers.paperLevel: A multimodal dataset of images and text assembled by DeepMind, used to train the multimodal LLM Flamingo. No size, composition breakdown, or licensing limits are given.

explainer.example: Flamingo is trained on M3W, learning from paired web images and text.
